subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Her ________ behaviour in the interview revealed her clear state of mind.
solution:
The correct answer is '**conspicuous**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**conspicuous**" means clearly visible or attracting notice. (स्पष्ट)
 
• Her behaviour was noticeable during the interview, making "conspicuous" the most appropriate choice.
 
• The other options: "**shrouded**," "**subtle**," and "**obscure**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Her conspicuous__ behaviour in the interview revealed her clear state of mind.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Shrouded (आवृत)**: means covered or hidden from view.
 
• **Subtle (सूक्ष्म)**: means delicate or not obvious.
 
• **Obscure (अस्पष्ट)**: means not clearly expressed or easily understood.

36:T96c,

The correct answer is: Option 1</
